text:
```yaml
name: "Maintenance: Ensure Agentic Workflow Discussions Category"

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/*.yaml
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/*.yaml

jobs:
  check-category:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify workflow discussion categories
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bad_files=()
          while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            while IFS= read -r line; do
              if [[ $line =~ category:\ *\"?([^\" ]+)\"? ]]; then
                cat_val=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
                if [[ $cat_val != "agentic-workflows" ]]; then
                  bad_files+=("$file: $line")
                fi
              fi
            done < "$file"
          done < <(find .github/workflows -name '*.yaml' -print0)

          if (( ${#bad_files[@]} )); then
            echo "The following workflow files have incorrect category values:"
            printf '%s\n' "${bad_files[@]}"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "All workflow files have correct category."
          fi
```
